page_title: VER 0-1 ATA | Verona v Atalanta 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes a short corner kick.
90+4' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+2' A clever short pass gives Ederson (Atalanta) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Luis Palomino (Atalanta) replacing Matteo Ruggeri.
89' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Verona win a corner kick.
86' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
84' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Martin Hongla will be replaced by Suat Serdar (Verona).
83' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

81' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
78' Here is a change. Rafael Toloi is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
77' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
76' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
73' Cyril Ngonge comes off the pitch to be replaced by Thomas Henry (Verona).
73' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Ondrej Duda and he is replaced by Riccardo Saponara (Verona).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Pasalic leaves the pitch and Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) comes on.
72' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Federico Dionisi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
70' Lorenzo Montipo steps in and intercepts a long pass from Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
69' A cross from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
68' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.

66' What a chance that is! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
65' Martin Hongla (Verona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico Dionisi saw the whole situation.
62' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
61' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Filippo Terracciano (Verona).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darko Lazovic (Verona) will replace Davide Faraoni.
57' Federico Bonazzoli goes off the pitch and Tomas Suslov (Verona) comes on.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cyril Ngonge (Verona) was quite harsh and Federico Dionisi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
53' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
50' Ederson (Atalanta) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Federico Dionisi blows for a foul.
48' An accurate cross picks out Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gian Piero Gasperini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Emil Holm (Atalanta) comes off for Hans Hateboer.
46' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Federico Dionisi blows for a foul.
39' Verona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
34' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
33' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
29' Ondrej Duda (Verona) brings his opponent down. Federico Dionisi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
27' The resulting corner from Cyril Ngonge (Verona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ondrej Duda (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
25' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
23' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
21' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Some great play by Filippo Terracciano (Verona) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
17' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) offside.
17' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Federico Dionisi interrupts the game.

16' Davide Faraoni (Verona) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

13' 0 - 1 Goal! Marten de Roon produces a great pass that finds Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
12' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' A pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
10' Atalanta hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
5' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
4' Emil Holm (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is behind the touchline and Atalanta will take a throw-in.
3' Davide Faraoni (Verona) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Federico Dionisi is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
